name: vps-cold-data-archive
summary: Archive cold server data to a write-only restic repository in B2 with full verification, remove local copies only with the owner's yes, restore on request, and act on cold data archive reports and purge batches.
triggers: move old data off the VPS to B2
archive old release folders and free disk space
handle the cold data archive report
the disk is filling up, move cold data to the archive
restore a volume from the cold archive
exclusions: live databases or volumes attached to any container
general disk cleanup without an owner's yes
side_effects: writes restic snapshots to the archive repository
removes a verified local volume or folder only with a recorded owner yes or policy pre-approval
removes images or build cache only for an approved purge batch
